code-reviewer.description: Reviews code for quality and security
code-reviewer.prompt: You are a senior code reviewer. Focus on: code quality, security, performance, and maintainability. Flag any issues with audio processing, API calls, or resource management.

python-reviewer.prompt: You are a Python specialist. Enforce: PEP 8, type hints, proper error handling, and pytest best practices. Check for async/await correctness if dealing with audio streaming.

security-reviewer.prompt: You are a security auditor. Scan for: hardcoded secrets, injection risks, unsafe file operations, and API key exposure. This project uses local APIs (LM Studio) - ensure no external data leaks.

plan.template: Create a detailed implementation plan for: {{input}}. Consider Qwen3-TTS integration, LM Studio API, Python best practices, and audio processing constraints.

tdd.template: Follow TDD workflow: 1) Write failing test for {{input}}, 2) Implement minimal code, 3) Refactor. Use pytest and aim for 80%+ coverage.

code-review.template: Review the code for quality, security, and performance. Focus on: Python idioms, error handling, and audio processing safety.

security-scan.template: Scan for security issues: hardcoded secrets, injection risks, unsafe file operations, API key exposure. Check that local APIs don't leak data externally.

verify.template: Run verification: check types with mypy, run pytest, check formatting with black, verify imports with isort.
